comments.value: This also broke existing batch uploading tools.
I believe the copyright confirmation should be completed before the building process. Otherwise, it’s very easy to forget to click confirm while doing other tasks.
Super annoying to have to babysit the process for a second confirmation because we already clicked a check box

Thank you! I was about to make a canny post for this same reason, it's very common to hit upload on content, and then leave it processing in the background. After all, depending on the content it can take a bit sometimes. It's incredibly frustrating to leave and come back, only to see that it didnt actually finish because the popup for copyright popped up.

because it doesn't always pop up either. Why in the world was this changed from a checkbox? legally, it has about the same binding power, as long as it's there at all. This just seems like a change for the sake of making it more in your face. Which is fine, but perhaps put the pop up at the *start* of the process, instead of the very end.

Yeah sorry guys, but I agree that this is a pretty big UX failure best symbolised by @{614b50e0cbe33b0b2d80dd76|full_name}'s post. Look forward to seeing it adjusted so all user-input phases are together, not separated.
The copyright ownership confirmation modal has been moved to appear right after clicking "Build & Publish"

In the recent sdk update (3.8.0) the ownership confirmation flow was changed from a checkbox to a modal. Im fine with it being a modal but i don't like that it only pops up at the end of a build not the beginning. Its nice that it only pops up once but when doing a muti build upload with a big world i sometimes walk away from my pc for a bit to do something while its building and uploading. The modal pops up at the end of the first platform build before upload while im away from my pc. Making so i have to stay at my pc for the first build to click that button if i haven't already. Would be nice for it to show up when you click the build and upload before anything happens.
comments.mergedPostTitle: Show the new ownership confirmation modal at beginning of build instead of end
comments.value: This has bitten me several times already! It should come up immediately.

details:
This is kinda weird, but basically its kinda annoying because usually when I upload an avatar I hit the check box and click upload and when it's done, its done. It's been like that forever and it's pretty much just muscle memory.

But now the checkbox in the beginning is gone and now it comes up as the "copyright ownership agreement" at the end of compiling, where you have to click "ok" before it actually uploads to vrc. 

I think this change should be reverted or have this agreement come up at the beginning instead of at the end.
title: [3.8.0] Revert new "Copyright Ownership Agreement" to how it was before, as a checkbox
